How the floors were chosen ESTIMATE

Classic pivots use Monday’s high, low and close. The observed high, low and close are marked separately. [4] [5]

  • P = (H + L + C) ÷ 3
  • R1 = 2P − L, S1 = 2P − H
  • R2 = P + (H − L), S2 = P − (H − L)
The floors are marked. The bridge can still swing past them.

Deep Dive · Who held up the bridge?

The Kraken’s currency bill FACT

Reuters reported Brent futures down about 1% to US$97 per barrel around the Indian equity close on 9 Nov. The rupee closed at ₹93.9275 per US dollar versus ₹93.9050 on Friday, a small weakening. Cheaper dollar oil eases the rupee import bill all else equal. A weaker rupee offsets part of that relief. [1] [10]

Gold rises before the inflation test FACT

Spot gold rose 1.2% to US$4,112.90 per troy ounce at noon IST on Monday, according to Reuters. Softer oil tempered inflation worries. Tuesday’s US CPI can move yields and the dollar, changing the backdrop for gold and emerging-market equities. Watch the response across those markets as India reopens. [9] [11]

The cash-market handoff FACT

For 9 November, FNOScan’s dated provisional NSE/BSE cash-market row shows foreign institutions net bought ₹7,212.22 crore while domestic institutions net sold ₹7,172.53 crore. The dated row is a post-close update. The provider’s summary header carries an older date, so this edition uses the explicitly dated row and leaves gross amounts out. [8]

A narrow path across FACT

Nifty PSU Bank gained 3.73% and Nifty IT fell 1.22%. Midcap 100 and Smallcap 100 finished positive, yet the closing breadth tally reported by DSIJ showed 1,629 advances, 1,959 declines and 110 unchanged across 3,698 traded stocks. A weighted index can rise even when more names fall. [4] [13]

Diwali Balipratipada. The US October CPI is scheduled for 7:00 pm IST (8:30 am Eastern). The first Indian cash-market reaction comes on Wednesday. [7] [9]

Wed 11 Nov
Next NSE equity session

Regular trading opens at 9:15 am IST. Watch the post-CPI move in the dollar and yields, Brent, and whether banks hold their gains as more stocks participate. Tata Power and GRSE results are on the day’s calendar. [7] [14]

Thu 12 Nov

India’s October CPI is scheduled for 4:00 pm IST, after Thursday’s regular cash close. Rate-sensitive shares may respond to positioning ahead of the release. [14]
